sources.title: OpenAPI 3.1.1 specification
sources.use: Operation security overrides root; empty array removes requirements; empty alternative permits anonymous access. Implemented common 3.0/3.1 semantics; not a full schema validator.

sources.title: MITRE CWE-782
sources.use: Correct research mapping: exposed IOCTL with insufficient access control, not generic debug-interface exposure.

sources.title: LLM-Driven SAST-Genius

sources.title: QASecClaw
sources.use: Paper abstract reports 88.6% FP reduction with a recall decrease on OWASP Benchmark Java cases; not a universal improvement guarantee.

sources.title: LLMpatronous
sources.use: RAG/MoA research direction; not evidence of performance on the user hardware or TBHM findings.
